mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_delivery_log (delivery_id, package_no, order_id, order_no, operate_type, content, remark, operator_id, operator_type, created_at, updated_at, is_deleted) VALUES (#{deliveryId}, #{packageNo}, #{orderId}, #{orderNo}, #{operateType}, #{content}, #{remark}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorType}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT id, delivery_id, package_no, order_id, order_no, operate_type, content, remark, operator_id, operator_type, created_at, updated_at, is_deleted FROM order_delivery_log WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC
